title: Arundel Castle
identityStatus: Exact-QID current castle multipolygon; separate keep building part and two courtyard voids

controls.basis: Current exact-QID multipolygon, its two separately mapped voids, mapped keep building part and inner-gate tunnel route. Native East/South coordinates bake heading 0. Historic England publishes approximate motte base width 75 m and height 20 m, and keep 20 by 18 m with walls 9 m high. Current mapped keep extends farther including attached stair/well towers; retain its trace and record the dimension discrepancy. All remaining architectural vertical sections, roofs, turret outlines, bay rhythms and gate sections are original estimates from castle-operator and VisitEngland exterior photographs. No certified site elevation datum.

nativeAxes.longitudinal: Long castle axis is NW/SE. Native +X east, +Z south; authoring major-axis rotation is baked into vertices, runtime heading 0.
nativeAxes.origin: Horizontal exact-QID map anchor; Y0 at provisional bailey/motte base, keep wall attachment Y20. Artificial motte is included as landmark earthwork.

reconstruction.scope: Current exterior castle complex: oval hollow Norman shell keep on its artificial motte, attached stair/well mass, medieval northern curtain and barbican, open inner-gate corridor and drawbridge, three residential ranges around an open quadrangle, round corbelled towers, Gothic windows, pitched roofs and chimneys.
reconstruction.basis: Original deterministic geometry from attributed current map traces, published approximate Historic England dimensions and operator/VisitEngland photographs. No downloaded mesh, photo texture or copied printed plan.
reconstruction.referenceState: Current exterior interpretation. The detached Fitzalan Chapel, cathedral, High Street Lodge, estate gardens, surrounding town, interiors, heraldic carvings and natural escarpment are separate or excluded.
